name: Rashi Peripherals Ltd
title: Rashi Peripherals Ltd - 544119 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue up 51% to INR4,489 crore with price hikes ~20-22% of H2 growth; management plans 20% CAGR but PES units may degrow 5-10% in CY26 and inventory days were not cut.

triggers.label: H2 price rise ~20-22% of growth
triggers.quote: I would account half of it or at least 20%, 22% growth because of the increase in the price.

triggers.label: Inventory days 56, building stock
triggers.quote: we are also trying to increase the working capital of inventories.so that those oppor tunities can be expanded.

triggers.label: PES market may degrow 5-10% in units
triggers.quote: IDC also says that on an entire year basis, unit-wise, the market size could degrow by 5% to 10%.

triggers.label: 20% CAGR maintained, 10-15% PES as-is
triggers.quote: So we are very confident to maintain our trajectory of 20% CAGR in the coming year as well.

triggers.label: Gross margin dip from slow-moving stock charge
triggers.quote: We have some slow -moving inventory, I would say. We have taken additional charge on that

guidance.quote: So we are very confident to maintain our trajectory of 20% CAGR in the coming year as well.
So around the range of 1.5 to 1.75 is the range applicable to this industry.
Yes, we can expect around same range.

red_flags.label: Working capital rising; inventory building into price hikes
red_flags.quote: we are also trying to increase the working capital of inventories.so that those oppor tunities can be expanded.

red_flags.label: Slow-moving inventory write-down hit gross margin
red_flags.quote: We have taken additional charge on that and brought down the value of the slow-moving inventory

red_flags.label: Semiconductor subsidiary working capital stretched (100+ days)
red_flags.quote: the number of the working capital cycle is a little stretched and you see 100-plus odd days there

evasions.quote: I'm not at the privilege to give the specific numbers brand-wise because even as per our agreement, we cannot disclose.
Can we take this question off -line?
